'''Berit''' was a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] aboard the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']], he was assigned to the [[Dark Deck]]. Communication with him was lost after the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi's]] [[StealthX]] attack during the [[Battle of Uroro Station]].
